brief: Reduce the permissible load on Kingsley Green 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-699) according to ambient and cooling de-rating rules in MG-021. Consider emergency load transfer if the asset approaches its temperature limit, confirming the receiving asset's available capacity with MG-021 de-rating applied and verifying its condition per ERP-032. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period as required by MG-021.
